signatures.description: Implement a DNSSEC denial-of-existence validator in Node 20 that, given a signed zone's NSEC3 chain and a query name, proves NXDOMAIN or wildcard-expanded NOERROR by emitting the exact closest-encloser, next-closer and wildcard-cover record set (honoring the opt-out flag and the per-record hash iteration count). It must reject forged or incomplete proofs: unsorted or looping chains, iteration counts above the record's declared limit, opt-out records used to deny an insecure delegation incorrectly, and wildcard matches whose owner is not the closest encloser's '*.' label. For each of up to 100k queries over a 1M-record chain, return the verdict, the minimal cover set with normalized hashed owner names, and finish within a 5s budget.
